Check Stop Codons and Reading Frames in a Protein-Coding Alignment

codon_summary.Rd

Check Stop Codons and Reading Frames in a Protein-Coding Alignment

Usage

codon_summary(aln, code, verbose = T)

Arguments

aln

A named DNAbin alignment object.

code

Integer or character. Genetic code passed to code in ape::trans().

verbose

Logical. Whether to print status messages via cli. Default is TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns a named list with elements raw, tbl, and result.

See also

Other alignment: check_polish(), concatenate_alignment(), gblocks(), mafft(), polish_alignment(), split_concat_alignment(), summarize_alignment(), test_sub_model(), trim_empty_columns()
